cohort: Mothers in the Danish National Birth Cohort
finding: While mental health improved from pregnancy to 6 months postpartum regardless of delivery mode, mothers with emergency cesarean section experienced more symptoms of emotional distress at 6 months postpartum.
mod_finding: Mothers with emergency cesarean section experienced more symptoms of anxiety, depression, and stress at 6 months postpartum compared to those with spontaneous vaginal birth; mothers with planned cesarean section experienced more symptoms of anxiety.
